name: Eve Door & Window (EU)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth. Eve's support page says the current version supports Thread.

matter.note: CSA lists Eve Door & Window (vendor 0x130A, product 0x004D) with Thread and Bluetooth; two listings exist (firmware 3.1.0 and 3.2.0). Older units can get Matter through a free firmware update, so check the model on Eve's identify page.

apple_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). On Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). An older Eve page said Matter over Thread on Alexa was coming soon; Eve's hub page lists Echo models and eero routers.

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). Eve's hub page lists SmartThings Hub V3 and SmartThings Station.

home_assistant.note: Reached through Home Assistant's Matter integration, which needs a Thread border router for Thread devices.

hubRequired.note: Eve says it needs a hub with Matter controller and Thread border router functions. That is not an Eve bridge, so we leave it unconfirmed, as with Eve Energy.

localControl.note: The CSA listing describes fully local connectivity with no Eve cloud and no registration.

senses.note: Eve and CSA describe it as an open/closed sensor with time and duration statistics.

power.note: Source for the battery type is Eve's product page spec; retailer spec sheets also list one ER14250 3.6 V cell, included.

summary: Eve Door & Window is a small contact sensor that tells you whether a door, window or drawer is open. The Matter version talks Thread, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant can all use it through Matter. Each platform needs a Thread border router, and Eve says it needs no account or cloud. It runs on one replaceable half-AA cell.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router; it does not join a network without one.
Older Eve Door & Window units are Bluetooth/HomeKit and only gain Matter after a firmware update; once updated they cannot go back to HomeKit.
Pairing to several platforms uses Matter multi-admin; each extra platform needs its own Matter controller.
